title: Recording Storage Retention and Capacity
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=camera:health event=storage
| stats latest(used_gb) as used, latest(total_gb) as total, latest(oldest_clip_epoch) as oldest by nvr
| eval used_pct=round(100*used/total,1), retention_days=round((now()-oldest)/86400,1)
description: Tracks how full your NVR storage is and how many days of footage you are actually keeping.
value: Security footage is worthless if it rolled off before you needed it; watching capacity and real retention keeps the evidence window honest.
implementation: Ingest NVR storage stats; schedule daily and surface used capacity and actual retention days.
visualization: Gauge of storage used with retention-days indicator.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how full your camera storage is and how many days of video you are keeping, so recordings are there when you need them.
